subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should the Gateway wizard RPC permanently expose optional `installDaemon` so remote clients can own daemon installation while omission keeps current onboarding defaults?
rationale: The process-isolation repair is a bounded bug fix, but adding a generated cross-client Gateway parameter establishes a public protocol contract that automated review cannot accept on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept the additive RPC contract
options.body: Merge the branch with `installDaemon` optional, preserving omission semantics and the supplied generated-client coverage.

options.title: Land lifecycle isolation only
options.body: Ask for a narrow revision that keeps the non-exiting runtime fix but removes the new public parameter until its API direction is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive RPC contract
recommendation.body: Merge the branch with `installDaemon` optional, preserving omission semantics and the supplied generated-client coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor to the adjacent Gateway protocol schema/export surface.
